review:
Epic Bullets and Bounty is the high-octane version of Bullets and Bounty. The DuelReels, Bounty duels and 20,000x ceiling stay the same, but Hacksaw says the volatility is higher, the BonusHunt FeatureSpins mode is more likely to hit a bonus, and you can gamble your way up into the Epic Bonus.

On Hacksaw's own scale this version is wilder than the original, so if you've played the standard game and want something more extreme, this is it. If you're new to either, start with the original. In both, the demo is the cheapest way to see how often a Bounty chain really comes together.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Hacksaw doesn't publish the RTP outside the game – check the info screen
Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
